profile.headline: software engineer Airplane system ( modeling and simulation) at Boeing
profile.summary:
SUMMARY 
Extensive experience in Real-time/embedded system architecture, multi-threaded software design, software sustaining, and system testing. Strengths include: 
+ Strong decision making/problem solving skills 
+ Strong debugging and trouble shooting skills 
+ Strong testing skills (unit, integration, system testing) 
+ Strong networking programming skills 
+ 5 years of working with RTOS 
+ Strong C,C++ & Assembly coding skills in the critical real-time environment 
+ strong experience with multi-tasking OS, interrupt handling, boot loader 
+ Experience in distributed system and multiple cluster system 
+ Experience in Secure Network Router ( Data guard)
+ Experience in SElinux, Rehat, SUSE

TECHNICAL SKILLS 
Programming Languages: 
C, C++, JAVA, SQL, JDBC, ADA, Assembly (80x86, 68000 & Z8000 series), 
Visual Basic, FORTRAN, Perl, Unix Shell Script, XML, XDS, HTML, SOAP, WSDL, JSP, and JavaScript. 

Hardware platforms: 
INTEL processors, ZILOG Z8000 processors, M6830 processors, Sun workstation, HP Work workstation, Tandem/Toll Switch, STP (SS7) Switch, class 5 switch, and
Classified network Routers.

Operating systems: 
Unix/Linux (SELinux, Rehat, Suse), VAX-VMS, Various Real-time Operating Sys(VxWorks,pSOS, CEKOS..), redhat, SuSe Enterprise Linux ,Windows

Software Packages: 
Eclipse, Eclipse Jface, Eclipse, SWT development,Tomcat, Apache server, Clearcase, C/C++, and MS Office 

protocols: IP,ICMP, TCP, UDP, SNMP, SMTP, SIP, H323, MIL-STD 1553

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description:
Working in Boeing 777X & 787  AutoPilot &  Primary Flight Control Simulation.
working on flight simulation coding and testing.  Use Jira, CQCS, GIT, matlab, linux, and eclipse

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description:
Boeing Bellevue, WA.

+  Working on the SUSE and SElinux HardwareWall Project.  The box is moving data between  Domain and filter the data.  Write code in C++/C to support Exmeritus Guard   Executive to monitor and to control Tasks and Data Transfers between Programs and Nodes.  Also support data transfer between Transfer Programs and external  nodes.
-  work the database project use Java &  JDBC to extract tables and data from  Oracle database.    

+ Working Cyber Mission project
-  setup TomCat and apache servers to prototype Cyber Project. 
-  Translate the business process into BPEL
-  using Java and Eclipse Model FrameWork & Graphiti FrameWork to create Graphical Process Editor to automate Velocity process. 
-  using Eclipse JFace, Eclipse SWT in development the Graphical  Process Editor
-  Perform  lab support ( Configure, install software and admin support systems in the lab)
-  Perform testing  Secure Network Router

+  Working on Network Secure Server Project
- Migrate the Filter application to run on LynuxWork Separation Kernel
- Testing IPv6 support on the MLS Secure Network Server.
- Support testing and software development of the MLS SNS-3310 product toward classification of EAL-7 
- Support software development and software migration MLS Technologies to run on the new hardware platform (MIL-STD 1553) for the FAB-T program. 
- Support efforts to develop MLS Technologies. This includes Secure Network Server enhancements to new protocols ( like PKI, SIP, H323 for video and Audio)  in the SNS products.

+ Working on Network Secure Server Project.
- TCP/IP/Ethernet testing on linux systems and Network routers. 
- Design SNMP agent for Secure Network System to report Traps 
and Audit data to SNMP network Manager. Also design the specification 
Secure Network MIB. 
- testing SNS SMTP mail server
- add features for SNS SMTP mail server. 
- test multicast routing feature
